description: Plantage Doklaan 30-42 (BAG dates 1841-1890, one design): 5.0-5.4 m stuccoed fronts of a ground storey and three upper storeys; three axes of tall casements in moulded surrounds with a small cartouche over each head and a sill slab, ground door as a double black door under a plain lintel, a bracketed cornice with a frieze at 11.5-12.7 m and one pentagonal (pointed) timber dormer

match.note: Doklaan 30-42: BAG dates scatter 1841-1890 on one stucco design; keyed by eaves 12.1-12.3 and the face pin

pointed-dormer.note: one pentagonal dormer 1.9 m wide, 12.7-14.3 m, with a two-light window

rhythm.groundFloor: residential: double door and two windows

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 40 px/m gridded: ground sills 0.5 m heads 2.6 m, door 2.6 m; storey-1 windows 3.0-5.1, storey-2 6.0-8.1, storey-3 9.0-11.1 m; string at 5.8 m, frieze 11.4-12.7 m; dormer apex 14.4 m, 1.9 m wide; windows 1.0 m wide on 5.0 m

schemaLimits: the cartouche over each head is a plain keystone block
